notes:
## Changes
- List view: folders and scenes can be shown as a list as well as tiles. Use the switch beside the sort box. Each row has the picture, then the details in columns: for scenes the rating, favourite, length, quality, size, plays, last played and date added; for folders the drive, scenes, favourites, size, running time, main quality, rating and last update. Click a column heading to sort by it, and again to turn the order round. Ticking, dragging across rows, menus and keys work as they do on tiles. Video Shelf remembers your choice for folders and for scenes.
- Scenes can be sorted by Last played.

## Fixes
- After an update, the features that need Online details switched on now show straight away, rather than after the next start.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
